verdict.rationale: Swell positions itself for headless commerce and says developers can build storefront frontends with any framework. It documents a backend API with official Node and PHP libraries and a CLI for apps, themes and storefronts. It also ships a first-party storefront app, Proxima, with Liquid themes. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a client-side storefront API or frontend SDK, a published OpenAPI spec (probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of building a custom headless storefront.
